raw:
Daniil Kvyat was Daniel Ricciardo's Red Bull teammate for the 2015 season.

The race reports show Kvyat driving for Red Bull from the second round (Malaysia) onward, alongside Ricciardo. The 2015 final standings list both as Red Bull drivers, with Kvyat on 95 points and Ricciardo on 92. The retrieved reports don't include Australia, the first round, in full, so I'm relying on my own knowledge that Kvyat was also on the Red Bull roster there. That is the only point not confirmed by the search results.

ANSWER: Daniil Kvyat
